sanity-check.py.summary: Check that the installed packages import and report the ones with newer releases.
details: Imports every installed distribution, lists the failures with their error and queries PyPI for the latest versions, printing the packages that are out of date.

save_en.py.summary: Write the English side of a bilingual JSON list to a text file.
details: Loads the JSON records, writes the ``en`` field of each entry, one per line, to a ``.txt`` file next to the input and prints the path.

savepkgstocsv.py.summary: Export the installed apt packages to TSV and CSV.
details: Queries dpkg for the package name, version, architecture, status, priority, section, size, maintainer, homepage and description and writes ``/sdcard/backups/installed.tsv`` plus a CSV version with the same columns.

scolor.py.summary: Show random 24-bit terminal colours, fifty at a time.
details: Prints fifty random background colours with their RGB values in three rounds, asking between the rounds whether to continue.
scolor.py.notes: Runs its loop at import time; there is no command-line interface.

secretleak.py.summary: Scan a directory tree for hard-coded credentials and private keys.
details: Looks for AWS keys, private-key blocks, API tokens, passwords and similar patterns (plus project-specific skip signatures) in the text files below the current directory, skipping binaries, virtual environments and caches, and prints every hit with its file and line. Files are scanned in a worker pool.

setup_dotfiles.py.summary: Turn ``$HOME`` into an age-encrypted bare dotfiles repository.
details: Installs nothing but verifies the required tools (git, age, git-age-crypt), creates an age key pair, writes the ``git-age-filter`` clean/smudge filter, the ``.gitattributes`` and ``.gitignore`` rules and initialises a bare ``~/dotfiles.git`` with the ``$HOME`` work tree.

show_encodings.py.summary: Print the detected encoding of a file.
details: Reads the raw bytes, asks chardet for a guess and falls back to charset_normalizer when the confidence is low; empty files report ``utf-8``.

showenc.py.summary: Compare the encoding guesses of several detectors for the local files.
details: Runs the BOM/tokenize heuristics plus chardet, charset_normalizer, cchardet, UnicodeDammit, libmagic and ``ced`` (each when installed) over the files below the current directory and prints the results as a table.

similar_size_files.py.summary: Group the files below the current directory that have exactly the same size.
details: Walks the tree (``.git`` excluded, symlinks skipped), buckets the regular files by byte size and prints the buckets that hold more than one file, which is a cheap first pass for finding duplicates.

since.py.summary: Convert a Persian date to Gregorian and say how long ago it was.
details: Takes day, month and year in the Persian calendar, converts them with the bundled ``PersianDateConverter`` (including leap-year handling) and prints the Persian and Gregorian dates, the weekday and the number of days since that date.

site_check.py.summary: Compile and import every module in ``site-packages`` and write a JSON report.
details: Byte-compiles each ``.py`` file of the system and user ``site-packages``, imports every top-level module with pkgutil and saves the compilation and import failures to ``site_packages_sanity_report.json``, printing the two counts.
site_check.py.notes: Runs the full check at import time; it can take a while on a large environment.

sjby.py.summary: Rewrite a JSON object with its keys sorted by length.
details: Loads the file, sorts the items by key length (or by the length of the value list with ``-v``), re-serialises with two-space indentation and writes it back after a round-trip validation.

soniq.py.summary: Sort a text file and remove the duplicate lines.
details: Reads the file (optionally only the ``START_LINE``..``END_LINE`` range), sorts and deduplicates the lines, using an mmap and chunked processing for large files, and writes the result back in place. ``--quiet`` suppresses the progress output.
